searchText: A further expanded basis from the above post: https://ethresear.ch/t/erc-70-token-proposal/11540 I think you are mixing consensus with execution layer The notion of ERC20 token does not exist in eth 2 aka beacon chain Ah, got it. But in theory, can tokens be created on top of Clients? Wrote a piece of it within my post above. no, you are mixing Ethereum state and formal EVM spec with individual implementations What if a new architecture is created for new tokens to be created (not ERC-20 tokens specifically), did you read my post? yes, I read, and you need to get your terminology straight first any ERC you want to create should be built on top of Ethereum and EVM spec, not as some add-on for a client Hmm…. 🤔 More research to do… Thanks so much for the input <@!329594653097721856> ! Any more feedback you might have to push this project forward is gratefully appreciated! on a more general note, this proposal is a solution looking for a problem to solve, really Solidity is the go to language for building smart contracts today much more successful than the many surrogates compiled to WASM and deployed to blockchain are (those are not on Ethereum, but competing L1s ofc) but if we do accept that your proposal brings tangible value, the likely course of action would be allowing WASM on chain, with some token ERC for what said WASM bytecode should look like Got you. Lots of work to do. and I think eWASM proposal has been a never-ending story for what, 5 years now?... <@!818957367978885142> in general, I think it makes more sense to look at all the various rollups in the space, because all execution innovation will be there, not on the mainnet for all intents and purposes mainnet is ossified except for minor tweaks Ok, got it.
